facts.objective: Implement the sync: incremental from a durable checkpoint, idempotent on replay, bounded in what one run may fetch, and honest about how each change was acquired.

nodes.label: I1307
nodes.summary: The ChatGPT shape is mapped from evidence and never becomes the canonical model

acceptance_criteria: No vendor DTO field reaches the store or a capability without passing through the mapper
A branched conversation keeps its graph; no branch is silently dropped or linearised
Content parts keep a typed discriminator rather than being concatenated into text
A field the evidence does not support is absent rather than defaulted
The mapper is proven against sanitised fixtures with no live account
facts.current_state: Nothing exists. No observation has been taken.
non_scope: Any canonical field invented to match a vendor field with no consumer
Downloading attachment content where the declaration does not authorise it
facts.risk: Mapping ahead of evidence. Every field here must point at an observation that was actually taken, or it is a guess with a schema around it.

nodes.label: I1308
nodes.summary: The executable's share is one capability, shaped like continuity

acceptance_criteria: The capability is declared once and reaches CLI, HTTP and MCP through the existing registry with no second registration
No generated document, site dataset or published projection carries workspace content
A missing store is reported as absent, not as an empty success
majordomus-cli gains no dependency
facts.current_state: No capability reads .ai/local/workspaces/. continuity reads .ai/local/state/ and is the model to follow.
non_scope: Any new dependency in majordomus-cli; ADR 0025 forbids it and I1309 gates it
Any site, docs/generated or public projection of workspace content
Serving conversation bodies over HTTP before a person has decided that is wanted
facts.risk: The registry makes surfaces cheap, which is exactly the hazard here. The default for this capability is the narrowest exposure that answers the question, and widening it is a separate decision.

nodes.label: I1309
nodes.summary: The boundaries this milestone asserts are gates, not sentences

acceptance_criteria: A gate fails if majordomus-cli's runtime dependency list changes, naming what was added
A gate greps the store, the fixtures, the logs and the snapshots for credential-shaped values and fails on a hit
A gate fails if the store exceeds its declared retention cap
A gate fails if any published projection names a path under .ai/local/workspaces/
Each gate has a test case that proves it red before it proves it green, and each rule carries the x-majordomus block that makes it enforced rather than stated

non_scope: Adding a new CI job; these gates belong to jobs that already exist
facts.objective: Add the gates that make ADR 0025 enforceable: the dependency boundary of majordomus-cli, the credential leak check over the store and the fixtures, the retention cap, and the publication boundary.
facts.risk: A leak grep tuned to today's token shapes finds today's tokens. It is a floor, and the record says so rather than implying the boundary is proven.

nodes.label: I1310
nodes.summary: The subsystem is documented where a person looks, and the plan is closed against the repository

acceptance_criteria: docs/WORKSPACES.md exists, is linked from the documentation index, and renders on the site
The document states the distinction from ADR 0024's provider in its own words, so that a reader who never opens the ADR does not conflate them
The re-audit names every place a second implementation of an existing mechanism was avoided, and every place one survives
ADR 0025 is accepted or amended by a person, and its status reflects what was actually built

non_scope: Documenting a capability that does not exist yet
facts.risk: Documentation written from the plan rather than from the built subsystem. It is written last for that reason.

nodes.label: I1401
nodes.summary: The identity of a projected record is what the record carries, not what its title says

acceptance_criteria: A record is resolved by the identity it carries, and a renamed title neither loses it nor duplicates it
An issue carrying no identity marker is adopted by its title once, reported as an adoption, and given a marker by --apply
A title that merely looks canonical never captures a record that carries a different identity
A created issue takes its number from the creation, with no title search anywhere in the adapter
Reconciliation is provable against a fixture remote with no network and no token, and a fixture is refused for --apply
non_scope: Writing a GitHub number into a canonical record
Any change to what the projection renders
facts.risk: The 19 issues projected before the marker existed must be adopted, never re-created; the adoption path is the acceptance criterion that guards it.

nodes.label: I1402
nodes.summary: A finding says which of six states it found, and the state that could hide a person's edit is no longer one of them

acceptance_criteria: A person's edit is detected whether or not the canonical record has moved since, proved by a case for each
A record whose region was edited and whose canonical record also moved is reported as conflict, and --apply refuses it without --force
An issue claiming a canonical id this repository does not have is reported and counted, so --check fails on it
Every state is proved by a case that builds the remote as a fixture, offline

nodes.label: I1403
nodes.summary: Backfill the projection once, deliberately, and record what it created

acceptance_criteria: The dry run is read and its counts agree with the check before anything is applied

nodes.label: majordomus.context-integrity@1

nodes.label: majordomus.dag-integrity@1

nodes.label: majordomus.decision-records@1

nodes.label: majordomus.define-done-first@1

nodes.label: majordomus.deployment-contract@1

nodes.label: majordomus.depth-is-not-verbosity@1

nodes.label: majordomus.doctrine-wiring-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Doctrine wiring integrity

facts.statement: Every enforced rule resolves to a validator that exists, is reached from every command it names, propagates failure, is proved by a test that CI runs; and every validator is declared by a rule.

nodes.label: majordomus.enforcement-wiring@1
nodes.summary: Enforcement wiring

facts.statement: Every enforcement the policy declares is invoked by the hook it names, from a file the dispatcher executes, without a swallowed exit code.

nodes.label: majordomus.externalise-decisions@1
nodes.summary: Externalise decisions and durable state

facts.statement: Record every choice between real alternatives with its reason, and every blocker that waits on a person, in the stores the commands read; never leave either in prose only you can find.

nodes.label: majordomus.handover-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Handover integrity

facts.statement: The record resolver reports the handover for this worktree and branch or its clean absence; a malformed record is never skipped silently.

nodes.label: majordomus.handovers-carry-state@1
nodes.summary: Handovers transfer state, not transcripts

facts.statement: Write a handover as the current state and the next action, with computed front matter, and never paste a transcript, a diff or a narrative of the session into any record.

nodes.label: majordomus.isolated-parallelism@1
nodes.summary: Parallel work requires isolation

facts.statement: Keep one active task per checkout, and treat a scope claimed by another worktree as a boundary to report, not to cross.

nodes.label: majordomus.justified-escalation@1
nodes.summary: Escalate capability and effort only when justified

facts.statement: Run at the profile's capability class and effort, and when you raise either, record that you did and why.

nodes.label: majordomus.layout-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Layout integrity

nodes.label: majordomus.ledger-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Ledger integrity

nodes.label: majordomus.minimum-sufficient-context@1

nodes.label: majordomus.note-integrity@1

nodes.label: majordomus.obligation-closure@1
nodes.summary: Obligation closure

nodes.label: majordomus.one-worker-one-scope@1
nodes.summary: One worker, one clear scope

facts.statement: Claim the paths a task needs when it starts; if the fix is elsewhere, stop and record it rather than widening the scope silently.

nodes.label: majordomus.policy-completeness@1
nodes.summary: Policy completeness

facts.statement: Every policy value the code reads is declared in the skeleton policy, and no reader carries a default of its own.

nodes.label: majordomus.policy-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Policy integrity

facts.statement: The policy and every profile parse, declare a supported version, and carry no key the schema does not define.

nodes.label: majordomus.profile-requirements@1
nodes.summary: Profile requirements

facts.statement: A profile may require more than the shared contract, and finish refuses a completed outcome that lacks it.

nodes.label: majordomus.project-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Project model integrity

facts.statement: Every milestone and issue file parses, carries the id its filename claims, and contains no key nobody reads.

nodes.label: majordomus.projection-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Projection integrity

facts.statement: Every generated instruction file exists, matches the content it declares, and is never silently overwritten after a hand edit.

nodes.label: majordomus.prompt-capture@1
nodes.summary: Prompt capture is proven, or reported unavailable

nodes.label: majordomus.prompt-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Prompt integrity

facts.statement: Every reusable prompt asset renders, and every token in it is one the renderer knows.

nodes.label: majordomus.questions-store-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Questions store integrity

facts.statement: Every entry in the questions store parses, because a gate that cannot read an entry can be bypassed by mistyping one.

nodes.label: majordomus.retention-caps@1
nodes.summary: Retention caps

facts.statement: The ledger, the handovers and the checkpoints stay under the caps the policy sets.

nodes.label: majordomus.roadmap-integrity@1
nodes.summary: The roadmap is a projection, never a document

facts.statement: No document is a second authority for the roadmap; a hand-written table can neither list a version no milestone declares nor hide one the model does.

nodes.label: majordomus.rule-package-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Rule package integrity

facts.statement: The vendored baseline matches its manifest file for file, every effective rule resolves with its dependencies, no two rules claim one identity, and no project rule reuses the vendored namespace.

nodes.label: majordomus.schema-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Every object has a schema, and the rules resolve in one stated order

nodes.label: majordomus.scope-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Scope integrity

facts.statement: Work outside the paths a task claimed is not accepted as that task's work.

nodes.label: majordomus.session-lifecycle@1
nodes.summary: The episode boundary is drawn below the model, and its working context is local

nodes.label: majordomus.session-records@1
nodes.summary: Session records are shared objects with a closed field set

nodes.label: majordomus.sessions-are-workers@1
nodes.summary: Sessions are workers, not memory

facts.statement: Treat every session as a worker that reads state from records and writes state to records; nothing that only a conversation remembers is state.

nodes.label: majordomus.skill-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Skill integrity

nodes.label: majordomus.state-consistency@1
nodes.summary: State consistency

facts.statement: A task record is trusted only while it still describes this checkout: same branch, HEAD at or ahead of the recorded commit.

nodes.label: majordomus.task-continuity@1
nodes.summary: Task continuity

facts.statement: A task finished as partial or blocked leaves a handover record, not only a note section.

nodes.label: majordomus.use-case-coverage@1
nodes.summary: Use-case coverage

facts.statement: A capability the policy requires coverage for is demonstrated by an executable use case, and a capability without one is a named gap.

nodes.label: majordomus.verification-integrity@1
nodes.summary: Verification integrity

facts.statement: A completed outcome requires a verification command that ran and exited zero, with its exit code and duration recorded.

nodes.label: majordomus.verify-outcomes@1
nodes.summary: Verify outcomes, not activity

facts.statement: Accept a verification command's recorded exit code as evidence of completion, and accept nothing that merely describes verification.

nodes.label: project.a-tool-that-cannot-match-the-tree-refuses@1
nodes.summary: A generator that cannot match the tree refuses rather than rewriting it

facts.statement: A generator whose build does not match the tree it is asked to derive refuses, names both sides, and exits non-zero; it never writes.

nodes.label: project.a-worker-that-stops-leaves-its-work-behind@1
nodes.summary: A worker that stops leaves its work where somebody else can find it

facts.statement: Work is committed and pushed at the last point it was coherent, not at the point it was finished; whoever fans work out checkpoints it before it is lost.

nodes.label: project.benchmarkable-commands@1
nodes.summary: Every public command is benchmarkable from the registry

nodes.label: project.blocking-checks-cheap@1
nodes.summary: Blocking checks are deterministic and cheap

facts.statement: A check that can stop a command is deterministic and cheap; work in progress is reported, never blocked.

nodes.label: project.cache-is-invisible@1
nodes.summary: A cache never changes what a command observes

facts.statement: Cache only what is semantically safe, key it by the state version, prove it byte-identical over every read-only command, and keep a switch that turns it off.

nodes.label: project.canonical-order@1
nodes.summary: A collection has one order, owned by one place, and it does not depend on who ran the command

nodes.label: project.clean-room@1
nodes.summary: Clean room

facts.statement: The Prismatic name is the only thing carried from anywhere else: no internal paths, hostnames, component names, doctrine vocabulary or quotations.

nodes.label: project.commands-are-projections@1
nodes.summary: A command is declared once, and every surface that shows it is a projection

nodes.label: project.context-locality@1
nodes.summary: Context locality

facts.statement: Context lives in the narrowest directory scope where it stays correct; root files bootstrap and link; provider files are projections.

nodes.label: project.conventional-commits@1
nodes.summary: Conventional commits, committed and pushed incrementally

nodes.label: project.derived-files-regenerated@1
nodes.summary: Derived files are regenerated, never edited

facts.statement: A generated file is changed by changing its canonical source and rerunning the generator, and both are committed together; the fingerprint gate refuses the commit that does not.

nodes.label: project.derived-once@1
nodes.summary: Derived state is computed once per state version

facts.statement: Compute canonical truth once per state version, project it once where possible, execute only what is request-specific, and prove it with the work counters rather than with a clock.

nodes.label: project.design-tokens-declared-once@2
nodes.summary: The design is one typed declaration and every first-party surface consumes its projections

nodes.label: project.destructive-sweeps-fail-closed@1
nodes.summary: A sweep that deletes fails closed on what it could not read

nodes.label: project.diagnostics-decide-the-exit@1
nodes.summary: A return code is not the diagnostic channel

nodes.label: project.distribution-canonical@1
nodes.summary: Distribution has one canonical model

nodes.label: project.empty-is-not-failure@1
nodes.summary: An empty result and a failed command must not look alike

facts.statement: Distinguish "there is nothing" from "I could not look", at every boundary where one program reads another's output, and make the second one say so.

nodes.label: project.english-only@1
nodes.summary: English only

facts.statement: Code, comments, commits, documents and governance records are written in English, with no exceptions.

nodes.label: project.entry-converges@1
nodes.summary: Entering as an agent converges on a server; entering as a shell reports

nodes.label: project.envrc-is-an-adapter@1
nodes.summary: The shell entry point is an adapter, and repository facts come from one typed source

nodes.label: project.execution-events-are-typed@1
nodes.summary: A long operation reports typed events, and a transport only renders them

nodes.label: project.executions-carry-no-secret@1

nodes.label: project.finding-carries-reproduce@1

nodes.label: project.generated-artifacts-are-typed@1

nodes.label: project.github-projection-gated@1
nodes.summary: The GitHub projection is checked by a gate, not by somebody remembering to run it

nodes.label: project.hot-path-reads-once@1

nodes.label: project.interfaces-are-projections@1

facts.statement: A capability is defined once and every external interface is derived from that definition; an interface that carries a definition of its own is a bug.

nodes.label: project.land-and-publish@1
nodes.summary: Work lands often and small, and what is published is master and only master

nodes.label: project.native-cli-documented@1
nodes.summary: A native command line command exists only with its documentation and its executable examples

nodes.label: project.never-author-identity@1
nodes.summary: Never author identity fields

facts.statement: repository_id, branch, head, working_tree and changed_files on any record are computed from git and never written by hand.

nodes.label: project.never-reported-is-not-green@1

facts.statement: A check that has not reported is unknown, never passing; a change is merged against the trunk's measured failing set, not against silence.

nodes.label: project.never-store-transcripts@1

nodes.label: project.no-claim-without-test@1
nodes.summary: No claim without a test

facts.statement: A capability sentence in README.md or docs/ is backed by a case in test/cases/ or is phrased as a target.

nodes.label: project.no-counts-in-prose@1

nodes.label: project.no-machine-paths@1
nodes.summary: Nothing this repository commits names a path of the machine it was written on

nodes.label: project.no-network-no-eval@1
nodes.summary: No network, no telemetry, no eval, no silent overwrite, no recursive deletion

nodes.label: project.no-new-nouns@1
nodes.summary: No new nouns

nodes.label: project.operation-transport-parity@1
nodes.summary: A command is the projection of a capability, or it says why it is not, and the reason is checked

nodes.label: project.optional-complexity@1
nodes.summary: Complexity is optional, not ambient

facts.statement: Keep the core closed and the edges open; a change may add sophistication behind a stable mechanism, never mandatory complexity in front of the ordinary path.

nodes.label: project.performance-evidence@1
nodes.summary: A performance claim carries its measurement

facts.statement: No speed-up without numbers, no budget without a run behind it, no baseline update without a reviewable diff; observed values live in the benchmark history and the baseline file, never in prose.

nodes.label: project.product-surface-derived@1

nodes.label: project.providers-are-data@1
nodes.summary: What the tool knows about a provider is declared once and projected everywhere

nodes.label: project.reclaim-only-what-you-own@1

nodes.label: project.release-is-a-projection@1
nodes.summary: The changelog is composed and the version has one writer

nodes.label: project.rule-is-a-doctrine@1

nodes.label: project.rust-benchmark-coverage@1

nodes.label: project.rust-canonical-declaration@1
nodes.summary: One canonical declaration; modules compose capabilities; the root composes modules

nodes.label: project.rust-cli-evidence@1
nodes.summary: The Rust executable carries its evidence with it

nodes.label: project.rust-command-tested-in-file@1
nodes.summary: A command asserts in the file that declares it that it is what it claims, and is composed rather than registered

nodes.label: project.rust-hot-path@1

nodes.label: project.rust-public-api-quality@1
nodes.summary: Every exported Rust item explains itself, shows itself running, and is exercised by something

nodes.label: project.scope-is-declared@1
nodes.summary: What a worker reads is declared once, and nothing outside it is read or served

nodes.label: project.shared-server-resilience@1
nodes.summary: Nothing a client leaves behind locks another client out

nodes.label: project.tests-run-in-disposable-repos@1

nodes.label: project.the-version-is-measured@1

nodes.label: project.ui-conformance@1
nodes.summary: Every page of every web surface is audited, and the audit names no page

nodes.label: project.unknown-keys-are-errors@1
nodes.summary: Unknown configuration keys are errors

facts.statement: Every configuration file rejects a key nothing reads, and every state field is both written and read.

nodes.label: project.use-case-evidence@1
nodes.summary: A use case is proved by execution, and a capability is covered by a use case

nodes.label: project.web-surface-declared-once@1
nodes.summary: A web surface is declared once and every web projection is derived from it

nodes.label: project.web-surface-topology@1
nodes.summary: A web surface is discovered from its producer, never registered twice

nodes.label: project.why-catalogue-is-canonical@1

nodes.summary: What already claims a path is checked before that path is built
